name: Lufuradom
summary: Lufuradom (INN) is a drug and benzodiazepine derivative which, unlike other benzodiazepines, is described as an analgesic. Similarly to its analogue tifluadom, it was never marketed.

uses.en: It was described as an analgesic, but it was never marketed and has no established use.
uses.zh: 它曾被描述為止痛藥，但從未上市，沒有確立的用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被描述为止痛药，但从未上市，没有确立的用途。

fact.en: Its close relative tifluadom, another benzodiazepine described as a painkiller, works mainly through the kappa opioid receptor rather than the GABA-A receptors that most benzodiazepines act on.
fact.zh: 它的近親替氟朵同樣是被描述為止痛藥的苯二氮平類，主要透過 κ 型鴉片受體發揮作用，而不是多數苯二氮平類所作用的 GABA-A 受體。
fact.zhHans: 它的近亲替氟朵同样是被描述为止痛药的苯二氮平类，主要通过 κ 型鸦片受体发挥作用，而不是多数苯二氮平类所作用的 GABA-A 受体。
